follow-up time: From first antenatal appointment until delivery
cohort: 48 nulliparous women with a booking BMI > 50 kg/m(2) who delivered between 2015 and 2019 at a tertiary hospital
finding: Increased BMI in nulliparous women is associated with higher rates of maternal and perinatal complications, particularly a higher risk of emergency caesarean section.
mod_finding: For every one point increase in BMI > 50 kg/m(2), the risk of caesarean section increased by a factor of 1.36 in women intending on vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: >90th percentile for gestational age in 34% of infants
